description: Publicly described coaching topics, not angle targets or an endorsement.

principles.name: Preparation and posture
principles.intended_form: Purposeful preparation of posture and the ball before the shooting motion.
principles.evidence_required: Set-phase posture and repeated frames; single-frame angles alone cannot establish correctness.

principles.name: Connection and sequencing
principles.intended_form: A coordinated, repeatable shooting motion and power sequence.
principles.evidence_required: Time-aligned joint and ball motion, beyond phase-summary angles.

principles.name: Balance and body control
principles.intended_form: Controlled balance during shooting and follow-through.
principles.evidence_required: Multiple frames and an appropriate camera view; a single 2D offset alone is not a pass/fail test.

principles.name: Guide-hand mechanics
principles.intended_form: Effective guide-hand contribution during the shooting motion.
principles.evidence_required: Detailed visibility of both hands and the ball; current pose metrics are insufficient.

limitations: These are qualitative topics, not numerical targets.
Comparisons are descriptive and do not claim a player violates the coach's recommendations.
Two shots are insufficient to rate long-term consistency.
Derived outputs are not officially endorsed by SeeMikeDunn.
